guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: Band Mate replaces the Master file: rehearsals, songs and rehearsal comments in one place.
guide.login_1: Open the app link shared in the Zalo group.
guide.login_2: Sign in with the username + password from the Admin (or Google in Chrome / Safari).
guide.login_3: Opened from Zalo and Google does not work: choose "Open in browser".
guide.member_1: Home: see the next rehearsal and "My tasks".
guide.member_2: During rehearsal: open the rehearsal → Add comment → pick song, part, type the comment → Add.
guide.member_3: Done with your part: tap "Fixed". The task moves to To check.
guide.member_4: Need to add info: type in Notes (tasks you wrote or were assigned).
guide.admin_1: Create a rehearsal: Rehearsals tab → New rehearsal → pick date, time, songs.
guide.admin_2: Assign an owner + due date to each comment (default due = next rehearsal).
guide.admin_3: After rehearsal: tap "Send tasks to Zalo" to tell the band.
guide.admin_4: Next rehearsal: To check box → OK · Done or Reopen.
guide.admin_5: Track K2 on Home: target 100% assigned, ≥90% fixed before the next rehearsal.
guide.status_3: To check: owner tapped Fixed, Admin checks at the next rehearsal.
guide.status_4: Done: Admin confirmed it is OK.
guide.help_1: Found a bug or have feedback: send a screenshot to the band Zalo group, saying which screen and what you tapped.
